You are a parallel engineering worker on the ESP32-S31 openvela project. Workspace: /home/regex/work/esp32s31-openvela. The user explicitly requested parallel agents, prioritizing working hardware/BLE and a coherent final product demo. Read the applicable instructions and evidence. Do not access serial devices, USB/IP, flash either board, reset hardware, start heavy whole-firmware builds, edit maintained source/shared configs, edit the checklist, or modify previous evidence. The root owns board and build sequencing. Rootfs has <350 MiB free; write only to the assigned D-drive task directory. Read existing backups selectively; never recursively search all backups or the entire source tree. Do not expose credentials or dump raw private pairing material. Keep original test failures intact and distinguish separate firmware evidence from same-image integration. No publishing or communication to humans. Produce concrete reviewed files/patches and a concise result, not just an unexecuted plan. The root is building E400 cache-writeback-execution, normal korvo-smp-services with 17 ELFs. E399 started all four AppFS services then CPU0 faulted at Flash-resident esp32s31_writeback_all_locked. E400 moves exactly that helper to IRAM. Do not mutate those inputs. E398 BLE simultaneous advertising/scanning and E393 RPA pairing 20/20 passed, both single-core FLAT. Existing E166 and E159 single-core product demos are archived and verified but do not prove BLE inclusion.

Assigned output directory: /mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/parallel-product-convergence-e401/demo_delivery

Audit and assemble a reviewable final-demo baseline package from actual retained artifacts. Verify E166 image at backups/kvdb-file-write-recovery/target-build/prior/nuttx.bin against E166 closed-review, E159 clean-build image against connectivity closed-review, and inspect their real configs/source/UI operations. Identify the best coherent demo baseline and actual user-operable functions, distinguishing GUI controls from shell-only test commands and separate firmware profiles. In your task directory create a manifest of artifact paths/SHA256, concise executable demonstration runbook using existing safe procedures, and exact outstanding integration gaps. Preserve old files and do not flash, rebuild, or present historical evidence as current revalidation. Include how root can reproduce/freeze the package without secret data. Coordinate scope only through your result; no checklist edits.
我会先核对适用说明和留存证据，再整理可复核的演示基线、制品哈希及操作手册；所有新增文件只写入指定 D 盘目录，不接触硬件或构建输入。
我会按 `xts-board-evidence` 的证据核对规则区分文件身份、历史板测结果和同一固件集成状态，并保留原始失败记录。

The retained E166 image hashes to `9ccba518…bcab4`. The archive names need care: E166’s review is under `nsh-background-child-recovery`, and E159’s is under `korvo-media-connectivity`. I’m tying each claim to its exact image and review so later builds and separate BLE tests stay distinct.

E166 is the stronger baseline for a coherent local demo: its archived image includes Device playback controls and passed the recorded 100-cycle lifecycle test. E159 provides separate SD/Wi-Fi/TLS evidence, with playback driven from the shell. Both configs disable Bluetooth, so neither supports a claim that the GUI demo includes BLE.

I checked the startup scripts embedded in both binaries. E166 mounts `/data` and starts `kvdbd`, `servicemanager`, `mediad`, and `systemd`. This matters because one retained generic `rcS` says to start media manually; that script was not selected for E166. The package will include the scripts extracted from the actual images.

The runbook and artifact allowlist are ready. Independent review found two verification gaps—unexpected extra files and external symlinks could pass—and I’ve corrected both checks. I’m now freezing the selected files and checking the copies against their source hashes and closed reviews.

The freeze passed: 90 source artifacts checked, with 62 selected files copied into a roughly 13 MB package. Both packaged images still match their closed reviews and configs. I’m checking the verifier from inside the frozen package and recording the final checksum receipt.

Created the [verified demo package](/mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/parallel-product-convergence-e401/demo_delivery/frozen-v1/README.md): 64 files, 13.38 MB; 90 source artifacts checked.

- **Recommended baseline: E166** for interactive GUI/media.
- **E159 remains separate** for connected-media demonstrations.
- Both image hashes match their closed reviews; both disable Bluetooth.

Included: SHA256 manifest, paced demo runbook, frozen sources/configs, startup-script extraction, and exact integration gaps.

[Final verification receipt](/mnt/d/WSL/esp32s31-delivery/parallel-product-convergence-e401/demo_delivery/package-review.json).

No hardware access, firmware builds, maintained-file edits, or historical evidence changes.
